installation.title: Kiizama on your home screen
installation.description: Open Kiizama from its own icon, like an app, without visiting an app store.
installation.online: An internet connection is required. You may need to sign in again when you first open the installed app.
installation.installed: Kiizama is already installed or running as an app on this device.

result.accepted: Request sent. Complete the browser confirmation if it appears.
result.dismissed: Installation cancelled. You can keep using Kiizama and add it later from your browser menu.
result.unavailable: The browser could not start installation. Follow the steps below to add Kiizama manually.

step1.title: Open Kiizama in Safari
step1.description: Visit app.kiizama.com on your iPhone or iPad. If you opened the link inside another app, open it in Safari first.

step2.title: Tap Share
step2.description: Find the square with an upward arrow. Its location depends on your Safari version.

step3.title: Add to Home Screen
step3.description: Choose “Add to Home Screen”. Keep “Open as Web App” enabled if shown, check the Kiizama name and confirm “Add”.

step4.title: Open your new app
step4.description: Tap the Kiizama icon on your home screen to go straight to your workspace.

ios.note: On iOS, finish installation through the Safari menu. If the option is missing, check “Edit Actions” in Share.

step1.title: Open Kiizama in Chrome
step1.description: Visit app.kiizama.com on your Android phone or tablet. If you are inside another app, open the link in Chrome.

step2.title: Open the browser menu
step2.description: Tap Chrome’s three-dot menu. Its location may vary with the browser version.

step3.title: Install or add to your home screen
step3.description: Choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen” and confirm. Wording and options depend on the browser.

step4.title: Open Kiizama from its icon
step4.description: Find Kiizama on your home screen or in your app list and open it to return to your workspace.

android.note: If Chrome offers direct installation, a button also appears above. Otherwise use the browser menu; a shortcut may open as a browser tab.
